Scroll fade container

Source: R/tier1-display.R
shad_scroll_fade.Rd

Add CSS-only edge fades to a keyboard-focusable scrolling container.

Usage

shad_scroll_fade(..., axis = c("vertical", "horizontal", "both"), class = NULL)

Arguments

...

Child content and optional attributes.

axis

One of vertical, horizontal, or both.

class

Extra CSS classes.

Value

A scrolling div tag.

See also

Other shadshiny tier-1 components: shad_alert(), shad_aspect_ratio(), shad_avatar(), shad_badge(), shad_breadcrumb(), shad_button(), shad_button_group(), shad_card(), shad_code_block(), shad_empty(), shad_item(), shad_kbd_group(), shad_label(), shad_progress(), shad_separator(), shad_shimmer(), shad_skeleton(), shad_spinner(), shad_table(), shad_typography

Examples

shad_scroll_fade(
  style = "max-height: 8rem",
  htmltools::tags$ul(lapply(1:20, function(i) htmltools::tags$li("Item ", i)))
)
